en.headline: Chief Executive to hold first district consultation in Tuen Mun on Sunday
en.dek: John Lee and principal officials will meet residents in small-group sessions to gather views on the 2026 Policy Address and Hong Kong's first five-year plan.
body: Chief Executive John Lee will visit Tuen Mun on Sunday morning with other principal officials to host the first district-level public consultation session for the 2026 Policy Address and Hong Kong's inaugural five-year plan.

The government said the session will use a small-group discussion format to allow direct exchanges with citizens. Discussions will focus on two themes: boosting the economy and pursuing development, and benefiting livelihoods and building the future.

Lee noted that since the public consultation period began in June, he and his team have already taken part in more than 80 online and offline meetings with various sectors. Members of the public can watch the Tuen Mun event via television or online live streams.

zh.headline: 李家超周日赴屯門舉行首場地區諮詢會 聽取施政報告意見
zh.dek: 行政長官與主要官員將以小組討論形式與市民交流，收集對2026年施政報告及首個五年規劃的意見。
body: 行政長官李家超將於星期日早上聯同其他主要官員到訪屯門，舉行首場地區層面的公眾諮詢會，收集市民對2026年施政報告及香港首個五年規劃的意見。
政府表示，是次諮詢會將以小組討論形式進行，方便與市民直接坦誠交流。討論主題圍繞「推動經濟、追求發展」及「惠及民生、建設未來」。
李家超指出，自6月展開公眾諮詢以來，他與團隊已參與超過80場線上及線下會議，聽取各界意見。市民可透過電視或網上直播觀看屯門場次。
